fusions.name: Plummeting Flop
fusions.desc: Drops onto a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flattened Ground
fusions.desc: Stamps everything within 3.5 tiles flat, dealing 26 damage to every enemy there and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Anvil Indifference
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Slammed Rhythm
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, your physical damage rises 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
